Rules.InvariantScript:
SortByColumns(
    Filter(
        cmp_ProjectSelector.Items,
        IsBlank(txtPS_Search.Text) ||
        StartsWith(ProjectCode, txtPS_Search.Text) ||
        StartsWith(ProjectName, txtPS_Search.Text)
    ),
    "SortOrder",
    SortOrder.Ascending,
    "ProjectCode",
    SortOrder.Ascending
)
